en.headline: Disney Halloween Time continues at Hong Kong Disneyland through Sunday
en.dek: The villain-themed season runs until 1 November with stage shows and character appearances included in regular park admission.
body: Hong Kong Disneyland’s Disney Halloween Time season is under way and continues through Sunday. The event, themed “Party Like a Villain,” began on 18 September and runs until 1 November.

Park admission includes the seasonal offerings. Returning elements include the musical Let’s Get Wicked and character experiences featuring Disney villains. A family stage show, Mickey’s Happy Halloween Adventure, is also on the schedule.
The park is on Lantau Island. Operating hours and show times vary by day; visitors can check the official calendar for the latest schedules. The season ends on 1 November.
Organisers said the programme forms part of the wider Halloween activities across the city this month.

zh.headline: 香港迪士尼樂園「Disney Halloween Time」延續至周日
zh.dek: 以反派為主題的萬聖節季節活動至11月1日結束，舞台表演及角色亮相包含在一般入場門票內。
body: 香港迪士尼樂園的「Disney Halloween Time」萬聖節活動正在進行，並將持續至周日。活動主題為「Party Like a Villain」，由9月18日開始，至11月1日結束。
一般樂園門票已包括季節性內容。重返的項目包括音樂劇《Let’s Get Wicked》以及迪士尼反派角色體驗。家庭舞台表演《米奇與好友萬聖奇遇》亦在節目表中。
樂園位於大嶼山。開放時間及表演時段每日不同，訪客可查閱官方日程以獲取最新安排。活動將於11月1日結束。
主辦方表示，這是本月全城萬聖節活動的一部分。
